conclusion.zero_run_rule: The HRC zero-run preorder representation can admit multiple mathematically valid global baselines. Choosing the smallest valid baseline can flatten genuine parent/child chains.
conclusion.dsc_code110_policy: Use DSC MODELS->MODELS relation code 110 only to score/select among already-valid HRC baselines. Change the standalone default only for a unique strict improvement; never post-hoc reparent individual nodes from code 110.
conclusion.class0_rule: Only class-0/subtype-0 records are HRC transform/null hierarchy nodes. The 13 class-0/nonzero records in the primary corpus are internal/helper payload records and must not participate in the preorder model tree or generic immediate-SRT decoding.
conclusion.result: With DSC-backed baseline selection plus the class-0/subtype-0 hierarchy rule, all 1,180 discovered scenes and all 3,815 declared roots have zero known hierarchy violations against every uniquely mapped DSC code-110 parent constraint.

resolved_class0_cases.after: torus9 naturally becomes depth-14 child of smerge44 and all 356 mapped code-110 constraints agree. Full reconstruction then proceeds past hierarchy and exposes an unrelated unsupported class-1/subtype-3 ROOT primitive.
LCANTILEVER_4 and LCANTILEVER_3 naturally become children of lfin_1 and lfin_2. Full reduced-tessellation reconstruction succeeds with 64 nodes, 20 meshes, 20 primitives, 6 materials and 3 images.

reproducibility.note: The committed census tool caches HRC parsing by source/member while keeping DSC scoring scene-specific. The final post-filter validation was also run in two deterministic scene ranges (1-1050 and 1051-1180) to fit the qualification sandbox execution window.
